NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL
  MAY 23, 2026
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 8:00 AM on Saturday, May 23, 2026 in Conference Room No. 4, Norwalk City Hall, 12700
Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

  (Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the item listed. Please fill out a speaker card and
  turn it in to the City Clerk before the meeting commences.)

CALL TO ORDER
Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

REPORTS
FISCAL YEAR 2026/27 PROPOSED BUDGET
The Fiscal Year 2026/27 Proposed Budget is presented for discussion and direction.

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less than 24-hours
before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following newspapers: Herald
American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on May 18, 2026.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at this meeting.
Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet, can be made available
in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services
are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or
service.
